summary: Canagold Resources Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a November 3, 2026 press release reporting assay results from four additional holes of its completed 14-hole, 7,277 m resource infill and expansion drill program at the 100%-owned New Polaris Gold Project in northwestern British Columbia. Highlights include 37.7 g/t Au and 4.57% Sb over 4.62 m in hole NP26-10A, including 79.3 g/t Au and 8.76% Sb over 1.96 m, plus 21.1 g/t Au over 9.44 m in NP26-11. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are disclosed; this is routine exploration disclosure, not a special situation. Watch resource-update and economics catalysts.
